counterfactual.resultDetail: Scenario simulation — does not create a real alert and is never shown as an operational signal.
counterfactual.noChangeApplied: No hypothetical change was applied, so the assessment is unchanged.
counterfactual.supportingIncrease: The hypothetical change adds {{count}} more supporting source(s), so the signal is corroborated by more independent sources.
counterfactual.supportingDecrease: The hypothetical change removes {{count}} supporting source(s), so the signal has less independent corroboration.
counterfactual.conflictingIncrease: A hypothetical source now conflicts with the trend, reducing the strength of the evidence.
counterfactual.missingIncrease: A previously reported source is hypothetically missing, weakening reporting completeness.
counterfactual.missingDecrease: A previously missing source hypothetically reports now, improving reporting completeness.
counterfactual.noEffect: The hypothetical value(s) below were applied, but they did not change which sources support or conflict with this signal, so the evidence assessment stays the same.
counterfactual.safetyMoved: Safety moved from {{before}} to {{after}} based on this hypothetical evidence.
